mainEntity.name: How long does interior repair on a mobile home usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest repairs are usually cosmetic ones like paint, trim, patching, and minor cabinet work. Jobs involving wet subfloors, damaged insulation, or wall replacements take longer because materials may need to dry out first and the damaged area has to be opened, inspected, and rebuilt.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor cosmetic repairs can often be done quickly. Water-damage repairs, flooring replacement, and wall rebuilds usually take longer because they require inspection, drying, and more labor.
